profile_text.body:
Baidu is a Chinese internet company that operates what it describes as the world's leading Chinese-language search engine, with a database of more than one hundred billion Chinese web pages. The company's own site presents its core mission as helping users find information more easily and quickly across the web.

Baidu also develops large language models under the ERNIE brand, tracked here as a Chinese foundation model, with the note that cross-border data review is advised for users outside China. Baidu is a publicly traded company listed under the ticker BIDU with SEC CIK 0001329099.
